mutations.name: treat a gh exec failure as a no-identity answer (could-not-run rounded up to clean)

mutations.new: return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: could not run gh api user: %v", ErrNoAmbientIdentity, oneLine(err.Error()))

mutations.name: drop the timeout detection (a hung gh stops being reported as a timeout)
